name: incidents
description: Every incident the operations team opened against the site, one row each, in the order they were raised. Incident ids restart at 001 each calendar year. Severity runs sev1 (tenant-visible outage) through sev4 (cosmetic or reporting only), minutes_to_resolve is exactly the gap between opened_at and resolved_at, and client_impact marks the incidents a tenant could notice without being told.

records.summary: Rack R03 inlet air warmed to 29 °C overnight when the east CRAC unit locked out on a high-pressure alarm.
records.root_cause: A clogged condenser filter tripped the head-pressure switch, and the filter change had slipped two months past its interval.

records.summary: The management VLAN lost reachability to twelve nodes in R02, so operators could not reach any of their BMCs for most of the night shift.
records.root_cause: A newly cabled top-of-rack switch came up with the default bridge priority and took the spanning-tree root role away from the core pair.

records.summary: Pinewire Fiber began upstream maintenance an hour early and dropped the secondary uplink while the primary was already drained for a switch upgrade.
records.root_cause: The maintenance notice went to a retired distribution list, so the carrier window was never reconciled with the planned upgrade.

records.summary: Four H100 cards on gpu-a02 fell off the PCIe bus and ended a sixteen-GPU fine-tune for Halvorsen Reasoning Lab at step 41,000.
records.root_cause: A riser cable left loose during the February rebuild worked its way free under thermal cycling.

records.summary: The nightly embedding refill exited after its first shard and left 1,412 documents without vectors until the morning rerun.
records.root_cause: A schema change added a nullable tags column and the refill treated the null as a fatal parse error instead of an empty list.

records.summary: Snapshot retention on the datasets volume stopped pruning and free space slid from 40 percent to 9 percent over a week.
records.root_cause: The pruning job ran under a service token that had expired, and its only complaint went to a log file nobody reads.

records.summary: Rack R02 lost its B feed when breaker B7 tripped during a scheduled load test, leaving eight nodes running without redundancy.
records.root_cause: Two spare nodes had been racked without updating the circuit budget, so the test crossed the per-feed limit.

records.summary: A credential-stuffing burst against the tenant API ran for an hour and a half before per-account rate limits absorbed it.
records.root_cause: Rate limiting was scoped per source address and the traffic rotated through a wide pool of them.

records.summary: Checkpoint writes for stonebriar-ticket-triage-3b failed for an hour and a half when the shared export flipped to read-only.
records.root_cause: The export hit its inode limit after a run was configured to checkpoint every step rather than every epoch.

records.summary: The status command reported every database as degraded while all seven were in fact healthy.
records.root_cause: The health check compared live row counts against a cached manifest that the previous backup had failed to refresh.

records.summary: The site transferred to generator during a utility sag and one PDU in R04 never came back, dropping six inference nodes that serve Kestrel & Fern Outfitters.
records.root_cause: The PDU's transfer switch carried a failed control board that only revealed itself under a live transfer, not during monthly self-tests.

records.summary: Card AST-GPU-017 logged 64 corrected ECC errors in a single hour and was drained out of gpu-b01 mid-shift.
records.root_cause: The card had run with a marginal HBM stack since its June repair and finally crossed the threshold that forces an RMA.

records.summary: Traffic for Saffron Lane Pantry ran at roughly 40 percent packet loss on the north uplink for just over two hours.
records.root_cause: An optic on the north uplink degraded gradually and the link never dropped, so nothing triggered a failover.

records.summary: The chilled-water loop lost pressure and the R01 rear-door exchangers warmed steadily until the loop was topped back up.
records.root_cause: A weeping valve gland on the return header had been bleeding the loop down for several weeks.

records.summary: Semantic search ranked results oddly for any query longer than about eight words.
records.root_cause: Queries were clipped to the tokenizer window before scoring, so the trailing terms never reached the ranker.

records.summary: A revoked API token belonging to Marigold Annotation Works kept authenticating for six hours after it was withdrawn.
records.root_cause: Revocations were written to the database but the gateway cached token state with no invalidation hook.

records.summary: Eight GPUs across gpu-c01 and gpu-c02 throttled to half clocks and roughly doubled inference latency for Northgate Logistics.
records.root_cause: A firmware rollout set a thermal target the rear-door exchangers could not hold once the racks reached full load.

records.summary: Backups of the audit database reported success while writing zero-length files four nights running.
records.root_cause: The backup script opened its output file before checking that the destination volume was mounted.

records.summary: Inbound TLS handshakes failed for about fifty minutes after a certificate renewal landed without its intermediate.
records.root_cause: The renewal tool wrote only the leaf certificate and the gateway reloaded it before anyone noticed the missing chain.

records.summary: A failing fan tray in the R04 rear door pushed outlet temperature to 44 °C and forced four nodes into a throttled state.
records.root_cause: Two of the tray's six fans had failed weeks apart, and the alarm only fires when an entire tray drops out.

records.summary: The job queue stopped dispatching for thirty-five minutes while one malformed payload was retried in a tight loop.
records.root_cause: The payload raised before the retry counter was incremented, so the job never reached its dead-letter limit.

records.summary: A UPS battery string failed its monthly self-test and dropped the R03 A feed onto bypass for the rest of the morning.
records.root_cause: One cell in the string had vented and pushed the string impedance past the test threshold.

records.summary: A misconfigured object bucket left evaluation exports for two tenants readable by anyone holding the URL for most of a morning.
records.root_cause: A deployment template shipped with public read access enabled and nothing compared it against the storage baseline before apply.

records.summary: Two A10 cards sitting on the STORE-A spares shelf were recorded as in-service after a stocktake, which skewed capacity reporting for a day.
records.root_cause: The stocktake import matched rows on host name, and both cards still carried the host they had been pulled from.

records.summary: A vector index rebuild ran out of scratch space and left search answering from a half-built index for nearly three hours.
records.root_cause: The rebuild wrote its temporary index onto the volume it was reading from, which had no headroom for two copies.

name: vendor_contracts
description: Supplier agreements behind the site, one row per contract, priced per month in US dollars. Vendors are the supplier organizations in organizations.json. end_date is the current end of the agreement, and renewal_notice_days is how far ahead notice must be served. Status is read against 2026-09-20: active, pending-renewal once inside the notice window, expired once the end date has passed, renewed where a later row on this sheet supersedes the agreement, and terminated where it was ended rather than allowed to run on.
